theme: An open day at sea, one meeting on tomorrow's horizon.
greeting: A wide-open day, Dan — nothing on the calendar until tomorrow's NACD programming call. The main pull today is the trip's loose ends, and one of them closes at midnight local.

needsAttention.title: Lock the Cavtat arrival logistics
needsAttention.detail: Free cancellation on the Sept 19 Cavtat room ends tonight, and the airport transfer, an early bag hold, and the ~5 AM Sunday checkout all need arranging from shore before Saturday — charter connectivity won't allow it later.

needsAttention.title: NACD New England programming call
needsAttention.detail: The programming committee meets tomorrow at 1 PM ET on Zoom; a few concrete programming ideas to arrive holding would carry the hour.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week is the hardest rental in that market and sells out early — a refundable hold now (p1, a day overdue) removes the whole risk.

needsAttention.title: Florida car and the St Pete gap
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 20–Oct 5 full-size SUV still needs booking before you land TPA on the 20th, and the check for a better St Pete Airbnb closes when the Sept 18 charge hits.

flagged.title: AT&T autopay went through
flagged.detail: Payment confirmed on the account ending 5042 via Amex — a record, no action.

flagged.title: FICO flagged a credit-report change
flagged.detail: myFICO reports movement on your TransUnion score and balances; worth a look when you're back on shore.

flagged.title: ICGN Toronto conference is open
flagged.detail: Registration invite for the autumn governance conference — on-point for the board search if the dates work.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters and shopping — Resy, Chairish, Monocle, NYT Cooking, Folio Society, and a few Maine dispatches.
inbox.clear: Nothing in the inbox is waiting on your reply.
